title: Crabs with different kin
hook: Similar names do not always mean close kin.

knows: Animals can have structures and life stages that differ from humans.
doesNotKnow: The simplified branch joins horseshoe crabs with spiders, while true crabs lie on a separate branch in this comparison. Shared ancestry is not a claim that one living animal is the ancestor of another, and the tree omits many groups.

misconception: The observations in this scenario require a different interpretation.
objective: On a simplified arthropod tree, which pair belongs together among the chelicerates?

Does the diagram say a living spider is the direct ancestor of a living horseshoe crab? The branch represents a shared ancestor, not one living species descending directly from another.
